requirements.test_case: Visual and tactile inspection of the outer surface; pass if it can be cleaned easily.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflector shall not be rough.
requirements.test_case: Visual and tactile inspection; pass if no roughness is present on the outer surface.

requirements.text: Any protuberances on the outer surface of the retro-reflector shall not prevent easy cleaning.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of outer surface geometry; pass if protuberances do not hinder cleaning.

requirements.text: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflector when in normal use.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of the lamp as mounted; pass if the inner (reflective) surface of the retro-reflector is not accessible in normal use.

requirements.text: If the retro-reflector consists of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, these shall be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
requirements.test_case: Design review and manual separation attempt under normal-use conditions; pass if optical unit and filter cannot be separated.

requirements.text: The retro-reflecting optical unit and filter shall not be coloured by means of paint or varnish.
requirements.test_case: Material/drawing review and inspection of samples; pass if colour is obtained by the material itself (e.g. coloured mass), not by paint or varnish.

requirements.text: For testing the colour of the red rear retro-reflector, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric test per R150 para. 4.2.1.2. Set up CIE Standard Illuminant A with 1/3° divergence and β1 = β2 = 0°. If a colourless surface reflection occurs, use the angle given in Annex 4, Part 1, para. 1.1. Pass if the test geometry and illuminant are documented as specified.

requirements.text: When illuminated under the conditions of paragraph 4.2.1.2, the trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity of the rear retro-reflector shall be within the limits for the night-time colour (red) of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Measure the x,y chromaticity coordinates of the retro-reflected light with a spectroradiometer or colorimeter under Illuminant A, 1/3° divergence, β1 = β2 = 0° (or the alternative angle from Annex 4, Part 1, para. 1.1). Pass if the coordinates lie within the red night-time retro-reflected colour boundaries defined in UN R48.

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of shape and dimensions per Annex 5 on all ten samples (Table 4); pass if Annex 5 requirements are met

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
requirements.test_case: Photometry per Part 1 of Annex 4 and colorimetry per paragraph 4.2.1; pass if RI values of 5.1.4 and colour limits of 5.1.5 are met

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective device.
requirements.test_case: Test sequence of Table 4 (Classes IA, IB) on ten samples; pass if all tests and subsequent visual, colour and photometric checks are satisfactory

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall withstand the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6 (48 h at 65 °C ± 2 °C) without distortion and, at least one hour after this test, shall meet the colorimetric requirements of paragraph 5.1.5. and the RI requirements of paragraph 5.1.4. for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: All ten samples: 48 h at 65 ± 2 °C per Part 1 Annex 6; visual check for distortion; after ≥1 h, colorimetry and RI at α = 20', β1 = β2 = 0° (or positions of Part 1 Annex 4 para 1.1/1.2); pass if no distortion and limits met; min and max samples then fully photometrically tested

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall pass the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6) and subsequently the tests for resistance to fuels and lubricants (Parts 1 and 2 of Annex 7).
requirements.test_case: First group (2 samples): water 10 min normal + 10 min inverted position, visual inspection; motor fuels 5 min and oils 5 min with visual inspection; then colour and RI at 20', β1 = β2 = 0°; pass if no water penetration/damage and colour and RI comply

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall, if necessary, pass the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6 and then the abrasive-strength test of the rear face of the retro-reflective device in Part 5 of Annex 6.
requirements.test_case: Second group (2 samples): corrosion 24 h, 2 h interval, 24 h, visual inspection; rear face abrasion 1 min, visual inspection; then colour and RI at 20', β1 = β2 = 0°; pass if compliant

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall pass the test for stability in time of the optical properties of the retro-reflective device in Part 3 of Annex 4.
requirements.test_case: Third group (2 samples): stability in time per Part 3 Annex 4; then colorimetry (visual or trichromatic) and RI at 20', β1 = β2 = 0°; pass if compliant

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall pass the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6).
requirements.test_case: Fourth group (2 samples): weathering per Part 6 Annex 6; then colorimetry and RI at 20', β1 = β2 = 0°; pass if compliant

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group must have a colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetry per paragraph 4.2 (visual, trichromatic coordinates in case of doubt) after each test group; pass if within red night-time limits

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group must have a RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4., verified only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
requirements.test_case: Photometry per Part 1 Annex 4 at α = 20', β1 = β2 = 0° after each test group; pass if RI ≥ 300 mcd/lx (red)

requirements.text: Where more than one or a range of axes of reference are specified by the manufacturer, the retro-reflector shall meet the photometric requirements for each axis of reference or for the extreme axes of reference of the range specified.
requirements.test_case: Repeat photometric measurements per Part 1 Annex 4 for each declared axis or extreme axes of range; pass if Table 3 values met each time

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI of the red Class IA/IB retro-reflector at an angle of divergence of 20' shall be equal to or greater than 3.00·10^2 mcd/lx at β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: Photometry per para 3 Part 1 Annex 4, α = 20', β1 = β2 = 0°; pass if RI ≥ 300 mcd/lx

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI of the red Class IA/IB retro-reflector at an angle of divergence of 1°30' shall be equal to or greater than 5 mcd/lx at β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: Photometry, α = 1°30', β1 = β2 = 0°; pass if RI ≥ 5 mcd/lx

requirements.text: RI values of the retro-reflector lower than those shown in the last two columns of Table 3 (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°) are not permissible within the solid angle having the centre of reference as its apex and bounded by the planes intersecting along the lines (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) and (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°).
requirements.test_case: Photometric scan within the bounded solid angle; pass if RI ≥ 100 mcd/lx at 20' and ≥ 2.5 mcd/lx at 1°30' throughout

requirements.text: If the Class IA or IB retro-reflector is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values are verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: If declared mounting height < 750 mm, photometry for downward angles limited to 5°; pass if Table 3 values met within that range

requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous flux of the red retro-reflector must be within the limits for the night-time colour red as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Measure trichromatic coordinates of reflected light per para 4.2.1; pass if within UN R48 night-time red limits

requirements.text: When testing the photometric performance of any mass-produced retro-reflective device chosen at random, no measured value shall deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the minimum values prescribed in this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of a randomly chosen production retro-reflector per this Regulation; retro-reflectors with apparent defects are disregarded; pass if no value is more than 20 per cent below the prescribed minimum.

requirements.text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', a retro-reflective device which is not marked "TOP" shall be rotated about its axis of reference to the position of minimum RI, and this minimum RI must conform to the value specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Goniometer at β1 = β2 = 0°, α = 20': rotate about the reference axis to find minimum RI; pass if the minimum RI is at least the paragraph 5 value.

requirements.text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 4. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', a retro-reflective device marked "TOP" shall be rotated about its axis ±5°, and the RI must not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed by the device during this rotation.
requirements.test_case: Goniometer at β1 = β2 = 0°, α = 20': rotate ±5° about the reference axis from the TOP position; pass if RI is at or above the prescribed value throughout.

requirements.text: For testing the retro-reflection, the retro-reflective device shall be illuminated with a CIE Standard Illuminant A (ISO 11664-2:2007(E)/CIE S 014-2/E:2006) and measured as described in Part 1 of Annex 4.
requirements.test_case: Verify the source calibration certificate for CIE Illuminant A; pass if compliant.

requirements.text: The shape of the illuminating surfaces of the Class IA or IB retro-reflective device shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape prescribed for retro-reflectors of Classes IIIA and IIIB in paragraph 2.1. of Annex 5, from an observation distance of 10 metres.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection per Annex 5, paragraph 3.3: observe the illuminating surface of the retro-reflector from 10 m; pass if the shape is not easily confused with an equilateral triangle as prescribed in Annex 5, paragraph 2.1.

requirements.text: In the case of a moulded plastics reflector of a retro-reflecting device of Class IA or IB, the retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C for the resistance to heat test.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 1, para. 1: place the retro-reflector sample in a dry oven at 65 °C ± 2 °C for 48 consecutive hours. Pass: the exposure is completed and the sample proceeds to cooling and inspection.

requirements.text: After the resistance to heat test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component shall be visible.
requirements.test_case: Visual examination after the Annex 6 Part 1 heat test (48 h at 65 °C ± 2 °C, then 1 h at 23 °C ± 2 °C). Pass: no visible cracking and no appreciable distortion of the device or its optical component.

requirements.text: For the water penetration test, the retro-reflective device, whether part of a lamp or not, shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 2 para 1.1: remove all removable parts; immerse 10 min in water at 50 °C ± 5 °C with top of illuminating surface 20 mm below water surface; verify bath temperature, depth and duration are recorded.

requirements.text: The 50 °C ± 5 °C immersion test of the retro-reflective device shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflective device through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 2 para 1.1: invert device 180°, immerse 10 min at 50 °C ± 5 °C with rear face covered by about 20 mm of water.

requirements.text: After the 50 °C immersions, the retro-reflective device sample units shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 2 para 1.1: immediately transfer to water at 25 °C ± 5 °C, same orientation/depth/duration conditions (thermal shock).

requirements.text: No water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit of the retro-reflector.
requirements.test_case: After Annex 6 Part 2 para 1.1 immersion sequence, visually inspect the reflecting surface; pass if no water is present.

requirements.text: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water at the reflecting surface, the retro-reflective device shall not be considered to have passed the test.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection after immersion test; any clearly visible water = fail.

requirements.text: If the retro-reflector is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling or lighting functions, these functions shall be operated at design voltage during the water spray test according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate), 55 min OFF.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 2.2.3–2.2.4: energise the functions at design voltage, 5 min ON / 55 min OFF, for 12 cycles (12 hours). Spray conditions: solid cone nozzle at 45° ± 5° to vertical, precipitation 2.5 (+1.6/-0) mm/min, device rotated at 4.0 ± 0.5 min-1.

requirements.text: After the water spray test and a drain period of 1 hour, no standing pool of water shall be formed in the interior of the device, nor be able to be formed by tapping or tilting the device.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 2.2.5–2.2.6: after 12 h spray, stop rotation and spray, drain 1 h with cabinet door closed. Observe interior, then tap and tilt the device. Pass if no standing pool of water is present or formed.

requirements.text: The device shall resist dust penetration that could significantly affect the photometric output of the retro-reflector when placed in the dust chamber no closer than 150 mm from a wall, with the test dust agitated at intervals of 15 min for a period of 2 to 15 s for the duration of 5 hours.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 3 2.3.2–2.3.6: chamber cubical, 0.9 to 1.5 m per side, max 2 m3, charged with 3 to 5 kg fine powdered cement per ASTM C 150-84. Dust agitated by compressed air or blowers and allowed to settle between periods. Devices longer than 600 mm are horizontally centred.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device shall be so designed that it retains the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which it is normally exposed.
requirements.test_case: Corrosion test per Annex 6 Part 4 and ISO 9227:2017; pass if photometric (RA) and colorimetric characteristics remain within prescribed values after the test.

requirements.text: The lamp combined with the retro-reflective device shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
requirements.test_case: Remove all removable parts; saline mist exposure 24 h + 2 h drying + 24 h; sample then assessed per paragraphs 4.1 and 4.2.

requirements.text: If the retro-reflective device has essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C, a saline solution obtained by dissolving 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.
requirements.test_case: Verify salt spray chamber at 35 °C ± 2 °C with 5 % NaCl solution in distilled water with ≤ 0.02 % impurities.

requirements.text: Immediately after completion of the corrosion test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection immediately after the 50 h saline mist test; pass if no excessive corrosion impairing device efficiency.

requirements.text: After the corrosion test, the coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9.
requirements.test_case: After 48 h recovery and cleaning of salt deposits, measure RA per Annex 6 Part 2 at β2 = 5°, α = 20'; pass if RA ≥ Table 9 value.

requirements.text: The resistance to fuels test of the retro-reflective device shall be performed with a test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol.
requirements.test_case: Annex 7 Part 1, para. 1: verify test fluid composition is 70 vol.% n-heptane / 30 vol.% toluol before applying to the retro-reflector; pass if the mixture is as specified.

requirements.text: After about five minutes following the wiping with the test mixture, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall not show any apparent surface changes when inspected visually, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
requirements.test_case: Annex 7 Part 1, para. 1.1(b): about 5 minutes after wiping with the 70/30 n-heptane/toluol mixture, visually inspect the surface; pass if no apparent surface changes are found (slight surface cracks acceptable).

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp (rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions and integrated retro-reflector) shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2., and notwithstanding any vibrations to which it may be subjected, it retains the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Inspection of the installed lamp on the M1 vehicle plus vibration exposure representative of normal use (paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1., 2.3.10.2.); pass if the lamp mounting stays secure and photometric, colour and geometric visibility characteristics remain compliant after exposure.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2., and notwithstanding any vibrations to which it may be subjected, it enables the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle-level installation check (position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections) before and after representative vibration exposure; pass if all R48 installation requirements for rear position, stop, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflector remain met.

requirements.text: It shall not be possible for the lamps of the rear combination lamp to be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.test_case: Design review and physical check of the mounting: attempt to fit and disturb the lamp in normal handling and service; pass if the lamp can only be mounted in the correct orientation and cannot change its aim/position without deliberate use of tools.

requirements.text: When the rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and rear retro-reflector functions) is fitted to the vehicle, the reference axis of each light-signalling function shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road, with a tolerance of ±3° allowed.
requirements.test_case: Installation check on the M1 vehicle, unladen and standing on a flat horizontal surface. Measure the angle between each function's reference axis and the road bearing plane, using the manufacturer's reference axis definition. Pass if the deviation from parallel is ≤3° in each direction.

requirements.text: When the rear combination lamp is fitted to the vehicle, the reference axis of each signalling function (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, rear retro-reflector) shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, with a tolerance of ±3° allowed.
requirements.test_case: Installation check on the M1 vehicle. Measure the horizontal angle between each function's reference axis and the vehicle median longitudinal plane, for both the left and right lamps. Pass if the deviation from parallel is ≤3° in each direction.

requirements.text: When the rear combination lamp is fitted to the vehicle, any specific instructions on fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.
requirements.test_case: Review the installed lamp against the manufacturer's fitting instructions, covering mounting orientation, fasteners/clips, seal/gasket seating and connector routing. Pass if every specified instruction is met.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the rear combination lamps constituting a pair (rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors) shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane, this estimate being based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.
requirements.test_case: Measure the installed left and right lamps on the vehicle (e.g. CMM or vehicle drawing check) relative to the median longitudinal plane using the exterior geometrical form of each lamp; pass if the positions are mirror-symmetrical within measurement tolerance.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the left and right rear combination lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane; this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Compare left and right lamp exterior geometry (CAD and physical samples); pass if the exterior form is mirror-symmetrical about the median longitudinal plane; differences in interior structure (LED modules, PCB, reflector) are disregarded.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the lamps of each function constituting a pair (rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors) shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates of each function on the left and right lamp per the applicable device regulation; pass if both lamps of the pair meet the same prescribed colour (red for rear position, stop and retro-reflector; white for reversing).

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the lamps of each function constituting a pair (rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors) shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics, except where the lamps form a matched pair of a function.
requirements.test_case: Perform goniophotometric measurement of each function on left and right lamps at the prescribed test points; pass if the light distributions/intensity values (or CIL values for retro-reflectors) are substantially identical, or, for a matched pair, the pair as a whole complies with the photometric requirements.

requirements.text: If the rear combination lamps incorporate a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo shall be fitted on the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle rear with all lamps; pass if no logo is present, or there are at most two lateral logos (one per side) or one central logo in total on the rear.

requirements.text: If the rear combination lamps incorporate a logo, any logo that is not a vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logo is prohibited.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of lamp graphics against design documents; pass if any logo present is exclusively a vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logo.

requirements.text: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical, the installation requirements of the preceding paragraphs for the pair of rear combination lamps (rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors) shall be satisfied so far as is possible.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation review: if the vehicle's external shape is asymmetrical, check the positions and orientations of the left and right lamps against the preceding installation requirements (e.g. paired-lamp symmetry about the median longitudinal plane, equal height). Pass if every deviation is documented and justified solely by the vehicle's asymmetrical shape.

requirements.text: When the rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector are grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another, all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, shall be fulfilled for each function.
requirements.test_case: Design review and installation check on the M1 vehicle against the individual function requirements of UN R48 for colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility and electrical connections. Pass if every function complies while grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated.

requirements.text: The photometric requirements of each lamp function of the rear combination lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of each function separately, with all other functions of the lamp switched OFF. Pass if the intensities meet the applicable photometric requirements.

requirements.text: When the rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with it (e.g. the stop lamp), the colour requirements of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the rear position lamp are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Switch the rear position lamp and the reciprocally incorporated function ON together, then measure the chromaticity of the other function. Pass if it lies within its prescribed colour boundaries.

requirements.text: If a lamp function of the rear combination lamp is a single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), whose apparent surface is composed of two or more distinct parts, then either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis, on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis, shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Project the apparent surface parts along the reference axis onto a plane tangent to the outer lens, using CAD or measurement. Pass if the projected area is ≥ 60 % of the smallest circumscribing quadrilateral, or if the facing-edge gap is ≤ 75 mm measured perpendicular to the reference axis.

requirements.text: If a lamp function of the rear combination lamp is a single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d), it shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
requirements.test_case: Apply the paragraph 5.7.2.1 projection check (≥ 60 % area or ≤ 75 mm gap) to the interdependent lamp system. Pass if either criterion is met.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of the rear position lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Switch the rear position lamp ON at nominal voltage and monitor intensity, colour and apparent surface over time (photometer/colorimeter, visual check); pass if no intentional variation occurs while switched ON other than permitted under 5.9.2.

requirements.text: Where the photometric characteristics of the lamp vary in relation to the ambient light, as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, or when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, any variation in the photometric characteristics shall be in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometry and colour in each variation state (e.g. day/night ambient level, position lamp ON with stop lamp ON/OFF, combined functions); pass if every state meets the photometric and colorimetric requirements of the applicable device regulation for that function.

requirements.text: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle-level visibility check per paragraph 5.10.4.1 (Zone 1, transverse plane 25 m in front of the vehicle, Annex 4); pass if no red light from the rear lamp is visible from the front.

requirements.text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.test_case: Observer moves within Zone 1 of Annex 4 in a transverse plane 25 m in front of the vehicle; pass if no part of the apparent surface of any red function is directly visible.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the rear position lamps can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously with the front position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp, except while the front and rear position lamps are switched ON as parking lamps, daytime running lamps are switched ON, or the front position lamps function is substituted under the provisions of paragraph 5.12.1.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle-level functional check of the lighting switch: operate the position lamp switch ON and OFF and verify that the rear position lamps (left and right) switch ON and OFF together with the front position lamps, the end-outline and side-marker lamps (if fitted) and the rear registration plate lamp. Verify that the exemptions in 5.11.1 (parking lamp mode, DRL ON, 5.12.1 substitution) are the only cases of non-simultaneous operation. Pass: no switching state in which the rear position lamps can be ON or OFF independently outside those exemptions.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the light emitted by the rear position lamp function with the lamp energised as installed; pass if the chromaticity coordinates (x,y) lie within the red chromaticity boundaries applicable under UN R48.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the light emitted by the stop lamp function with the lamp energised; pass if the chromaticity coordinates (x,y) lie within the red chromaticity boundaries applicable under UN R48.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the light emitted by the reversing lamp function with the lamp energised; pass if the chromaticity coordinates (x,y) lie within the white chromaticity boundaries applicable under UN R48.

requirements.text: The colour of the light reflected by the non-triangular rear retro-reflector shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Illuminate the retro-reflector with a standard illuminant and measure the chromaticity of the reflected light; pass if the coordinates (x,y) lie within the red chromaticity boundaries applicable under UN R48.

requirements.text: The number of lamps (rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors) mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the vehicle installation: count the installed rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors and compare with the numbers given in the individual specifications of UN R48 (paragraph 6). Pass if the count for each function equals the prescribed number.

requirements.text: If the rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp or rear retro-reflector) is installed on movable components of the vehicle (e.g. tailgate or boot lid), the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. shall be fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Review the vehicle installation drawings to determine whether any lamp function or the retro-reflector is mounted on a movable component. If so, verify compliance with paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. by inspection and photometric/geometric checks in the relevant positions of the movable component. Pass if every condition of 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. is met; not applicable if the lamp is mounted only on fixed body parts.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp is installed on a movable component (e.g. tailgate or boot lid), the rear position lamp shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for rear position lamps at all fixed positions of the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Installation check on the vehicle with the movable component in each fixed position (closed and each fixed open position): verify mounting position, geometric visibility angles, colour and photometric values per R48 rear position lamp provisions; pass if all are met in every fixed position.

requirements.text: If the rear retro-reflector is installed on a movable component, the rear retro-reflector shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for rear retro-reflectors at all fixed positions of the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Installation check on the vehicle with the movable component in each fixed position: verify position, geometric visibility, colour and photometric (CIL) requirements for rear retro-reflectors; pass if all are met in every fixed position.

requirements.text: Where additional lamps for the rear position lamp or rear retro-reflector functions are fitted and are switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position, these additional lamps shall satisfy all the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
requirements.test_case: With movable component in each fixed open position, verify additional lamps are switched ON and meet position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements of the lamps on the movable component; pass if all met.

requirements.text: If the rear combination lamp (rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions and retro-reflector) is installed on a movable component (e.g. tailgate or boot lid), then when that component is in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on it shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: place the movable component (e.g. tailgate open) in each position other than the normal position of use with the lamp functions activated. Check light directions and visibility from relevant road-user positions. Pass if no glare or misleading or disturbing signal causes undue discomfort to road users.

requirements.text: When the rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and retro-reflector) is installed on a movable component (e.g. tailgate or boot lid) and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: If any part of the lamp is mounted on a movable body component: operate the movable component repeatedly (e.g. open/close 10 times) and return it to the normal position of use. After each cycle, verify the lamp position and orientation relative to the vehicle against the manufacturer-specified installation position (height, width, angles of geometric visibility per R48 paragraph 6). Pass if the lamp returns each time to the specified position and all installation requirements remain met.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamp shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use" (fixed position meaning the stable or natural rest position(s) of the movable component specified by the vehicle manufacturer, whether locked or not).
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: place each movable component in every manufacturer-specified fixed rest position other than the normal position of use, locked or unlocked. Measure the projected apparent surface of the rear position lamp in the direction of its reference axis. Pass if no more than 50 % of it is hidden.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear retro-reflector shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: place each movable component in every manufacturer-specified fixed rest position other than the normal position of use. Measure the apparent surface of the retro-reflector in the direction of its reference axis. Pass if no more than 50 % of it is hidden.

requirements.text: If the 50 per cent limit of paragraph 5.21. is not practicable for the rear position lamp, additional lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamp is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component. These additional lamps shall satisfy all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for rear position lamps.
requirements.test_case: Functional test on the vehicle: move the component to each position that hides more than 50 % of the rear position lamp's apparent surface. Pass if the additional lamps switch ON automatically. Verify that the additional lamps meet the R48 position and geometric visibility requirements and the colorimetric and photometric requirements for rear position lamps.

requirements.text: If a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp is provided, the replacement function in case of a failure shall be similar in colour to the rear position lamp function that has ceased to operate.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of rear position lamp LEDs; measure colour of the replacement function and compare with the rear position lamp (red) colour coordinates; pass if similar/within red colour limits.

requirements.text: If a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp is provided, the replacement function in case of a failure shall be similar in main intensity to the rear position lamp function that has ceased to operate.
requirements.test_case: Simulate rear position lamp failure; photometric measurement of the replacement function at main test points (H-V); pass if intensity is similar to that of the original rear position lamp.

requirements.text: If a device is used as temporary fail-safe replacement for the rear position lamp, the replacement device shall remain operational in its original safety function.
requirements.test_case: With rear position lamp failure simulated and replacement active, activate the original function of the replacement device (e.g. stop signal); pass if it still operates and meets its photometric requirements.

requirements.text: During temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
requirements.test_case: Simulate rear position lamp failure on vehicle; pass if dashboard tell-tale activates for the duration of the replacement.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp of category R2 and the stop lamp of category S2 are provided with variable luminous intensity control, their luminous intensities, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, shall vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of the R2 and S2 functions at several intensity control steps under each triggering condition; pass if both functions change simultaneously, in the same direction and in a similar proportion.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp of category R2 and the stop lamp of category S2 are provided with variable luminous intensity control, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of the two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained in the entire intensity range and throughout variation transitions.
requirements.test_case: Continuous photometric recording of both functions during intensity transitions across the full control range; pass if the stop/position lamp intensity ratio prescribed by the pertinent UN Regulation is maintained at all times.

requirements.text: If the rear position lamp of category R2 and the stop lamp of category S2 are provided with variable luminous intensity control, no sharp variation of intensity shall be observed during transition.
requirements.test_case: Time-resolved photometric recording and visual observation during intensity transitions; pass if intensity changes progressively without visible steps or abrupt jumps.

requirements.text: When the electrical system of the M1 vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition representative for the vehicle category as specified by the applicant, the voltage supplied at the terminals of the rear combination lamp (rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions), where according to its type approval documentation it has been tested with a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant device or function as approved. Per paragraph 5.27.3, this does not apply if the lamp includes an electronic light source control gear, a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light sources approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle-level demonstration to the Technical Service. Run the vehicle electrical system in a representative constant voltage operating condition and measure the voltage at the lamp connector terminals for each function. Pass if the measured voltage is at or below the voltage stated in the lamp's type approval documentation. Not applicable if a 5.27.3 exemption applies.

requirements.text: In all electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1, when the vehicle electrical system is in a representative constant voltage operating condition, the voltage at the terminals of the rear combination lamp device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V by more than 3 per cent in 6 Volt-Systems. This does not apply where a paragraph 5.27.3 exemption applies.
requirements.test_case: Measure the terminal voltage of each function with the vehicle electrical system in a representative constant voltage condition. Pass if the voltage is ≤ 6.75 V × 1.03 (6.95 V).

requirements.text: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and rear retro-reflector) observed from infinity; however, no account is taken of obstacles if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.
requirements.test_case: Installation check on the M1 vehicle: observe the apparent surface of each function from infinity (or with parallel-shifted observation directions) across the full prescribed angles of geometric visibility. Pass if no vehicle part obstructs light propagation from any part of the apparent surface, except obstacles already present at lamp type approval.

requirements.text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of each partially hidden function with the vehicle masking reproduced, either on the vehicle or with a masking fixture. Pass if all prescribed photometric values for device approval are met by the unhidden part across the required field.

requirements.text: When the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal may be reduced to 5° (lamp at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5° below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Measure the mounting height according to paragraph 5.8.1. If it is less than 750 mm and the function permits a reduced downward visibility angle, verify geometric visibility and photometry of the installed optical unit down to 5° below the horizontal. Pass if requirements are met within the reduced field.

requirements.text: The LED modules of the rear combination lamp do not need to be replaceable, provided this is stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval; otherwise the LED modules shall be replaceable.
requirements.test_case: Document review and inspection: check the component type approval communication sheet. If it states the LED module is non-replaceable, the design passes. If it does not, verify on the sample that the LED module can be removed and replaced.

requirements.text: When installed on the vehicle, the rear position lamp function of the rear combination lamp shall be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulation (UN Regulation No. 148), as specified in the relevant subparagraph of paragraph 6 of UN R48.
requirements.test_case: Documentary check: verify a valid UN R148 type approval and approval marking for the rear position lamp function on the installed lamp; pass if present and matching the installed device.

requirements.text: When installed on the vehicle, the integrated rear retro-reflector shall be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulation (UN Regulation No. 150), as specified in the relevant subparagraph of paragraph 6 of UN R48.
requirements.test_case: Documentary check: verify a valid UN R150 type approval and approval marking for the rear retro-reflector on the installed device; pass if present and matching the installed device.

requirements.text: If the rear combination lamp (light-signalling lamp) incorporates a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Design review for presence of a manufacturer logo; if present, verify the UN R148 type approval covers the lamp including the logo; pass if approval documentation and marking include the logo variant.

requirements.text: A reversing lamp shall be present on the motor vehicle (mandatory on motor vehicles).
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify that at least one reversing lamp is fitted. Pass if a reversing lamp is present.

requirements.text: On motor vehicles of category M1, one reversing lamp device shall be mandatory and a second device is optional.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: count reversing lamp devices. Pass if 1 or 2 devices are fitted.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Document and marking check: verify a valid approval mark and certificate to UN R23 (00 or later series) or UN R148 (00 or later series) for the reversing lamp function. Pass if present.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in height not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
requirements.test_case: Measure height of the illuminating surface above ground with vehicle in reference condition on horizontal ground. Pass if lowest edge ≥ 250 mm and highest edge ≤ 1,200 mm.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify reversing lamp is installed at the rear of the vehicle. Pass if rear-mounted.

requirements.text: For reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility defined by angle α, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., shall be 15° upwards and 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check per paragraph 2.10.7. on installed lamp: verify unobstructed view of the apparent surface from 15° up to 5° down. Pass if visibility achieved over the full range.

requirements.text: If there are two reversing lamp devices installed at the rear, the geometric visibility angle β shall be 45° outwards and 30° inwards.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check per paragraph 2.10.7. on each installed lamp: verify visibility from 45° outboard to 30° inboard. Pass if visibility achieved over the full range for each lamp.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection/measurement of reference axis: verify reversing lamp reference axis points rearwards. Pass if oriented rearwards.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the reversing lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Functional test on vehicle: engage reverse with propulsion system operable – lamp ON; check lamp cannot be switched ON in any other gear/ignition combination. Pass if lamp ON only when both conditions are met.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either the reverse gear is not engaged or the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is not in a position where operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Functional test on vehicle: with lamp ON, disengage reverse gear, then separately switch propulsion system off. Pass if lamp switches OFF immediately in each case and does not switch ON when either condition is not met.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the reversing lamp shall be provided if required by the component regulation; otherwise a tell-tale is optional.
requirements.test_case: Check UN R23/R148 approval for failure tell-tale requirement; if required, simulate LED failure and verify tell-tale activation. Pass if tell-tale indicates failure where required.

requirements.text: Stop lamp devices of S1 or S2 categories shall be installed (mandatory on all categories of vehicles, including M1).
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify that S1 or S2 category stop lamps are present on the M1 vehicle; pass if fitted.

requirements.text: Two S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be installed on the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: count the S1/S2 stop lamps fitted at the rear; pass if exactly two (one in each left/right rear combination lamp).

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Document and marking check: verify a UN R7 (02 series or later) or UN R148 (00 series or later) approval and the corresponding approval marking with S1 or S2 category on the lamp; pass if present and valid.

requirements.text: For M1 category vehicles, the point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of each S1 or S2 category stop lamp which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the vehicle the lateral distance from the outermost point of the stop lamp apparent surface (in the reference axis direction) to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle, left and right; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be positioned above the ground not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure on the unladen vehicle the height of the lower and upper edges of the stop lamp apparent surface above ground according to paragraph 5.8.1; pass if lowest point ≥ 350 mm and highest point ≤ 1,500 mm (or ≤ 2,100 mm where bodywork shape justifies it).

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify the stop lamps are located at the rear of the vehicle; pass if so.

requirements.text: The horizontal angle of geometric visibility of the S1 or S2 category stop lamp shall be 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle; however, for stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on the vehicle: verify unobstructed view of the apparent surface over 45° outward and 45° inward (or 20° inward below H plane if mounted below 750 mm per 5.8.1); pass if the apparent surface is visible throughout the required field.

requirements.text: The vertical angle of geometric visibility of the S1 or S2 category stop lamp shall be 15° above and below the horizontal; however, where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on the vehicle: verify unobstructed view of the apparent surface 15° upward and 15° downward (or 5° downward if mounted below 750 mm per 5.8.1); pass if visible throughout the required field.

requirements.text: The stop lamps shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle installation inspection: verify the reference axis of the stop lamp points rearward parallel to the vehicle longitudinal axis; pass if oriented towards the rear.

requirements.text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.test_case: Functional test on the vehicle: apply the service brake (and other braking signals defined in R13/R13-H); pass if all stop lamps (left, right and centre high-mounted) illuminate simultaneously.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the stop lamps shall be provided if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check the component regulation (UN R7/R148) requirements for the approved LED stop lamp; if failure tell-tale required, simulate LED failure and verify the tell-tale activates; pass if it does (or if not required).

requirements.text: Rear position lamps of category R, R1 or R2 shall be mandatory on the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify rear position lamps of category R, R1 or R2 are fitted; pass if present.

requirements.text: The number of rear position lamps shall be two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the vehicle has exactly two rear position lamps and that each bears a valid approval mark to UN R7 (02 series or later) or UN R148 (00 series or later); pass if both conditions are met.

requirements.text: In width, the point on the apparent surface of the rear position lamp in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the vehicle the lateral distance from the outermost point of the apparent surface (reference axis direction) to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle; pass if ≤ 400 mm on each side.

requirements.text: In height, the rear position lamp shall be mounted above the ground not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the apparent surface above the ground per paragraph 5.8.1 with the vehicle on a substantially horizontal surface; pass if lowest point ≥ 350 mm and highest point ≤ 1,500 mm (or ≤ 2,100 mm where bodywork justification applies and no optional lamps are fitted).

requirements.text: In length, the rear position lamp shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the lamp is located at the rear of the vehicle; pass if so.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have a geometric visibility horizontal angle of 45° inwards and 80° outwards; where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on vehicle or CAD: verify unobstructed view of the apparent surface over 45° inwards to 80° outwards (20° inwards below H plane if mounted below 750 mm); pass if visible throughout.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have a geometric visibility vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal; where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check: verify unobstructed view of the apparent surface over 15° up and 15° down (5° down if mounted below 750 mm); pass if visible throughout.

requirements.text: For M1 vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the rear position lamp shall have a horizontal angle of 45° outwards to 45° inwards (inward angle may be reduced to 20° under the H plane where mounted below 750 mm) and a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal (downward angle may be reduced to 5° where mounted below 750 mm).
requirements.test_case: If the alternative is chosen, confirm rear side-marker lamp fitted and verify visibility over 45° out/45° in and ±15° vertical (with reductions per mounting height); pass if visible throughout.

requirements.text: When the alternative geometric visibility of paragraph 6.10.5.2. is applied, to be considered visible the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres, excluding the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light.
requirements.test_case: Determine the projected unobstructed apparent surface at the visibility angle limits excluding the non-light-transmitting retro-reflector area; pass if ≥ 12.5 cm² in each direction.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Verify the lamp reference axis points rearwards when installed; pass if so.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be present on the motor vehicle (mandatory on motor vehicles).
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify that non-triangular rear retro-reflectors are fitted on the M1 vehicle. Pass if present.

requirements.text: Two rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be fitted to the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: count the mandatory rear retro-reflectors. Pass if exactly two are fitted as mandatory devices.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflectors shall be type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.test_case: Document and marking check: verify the retro-reflector approval mark and certificate show Class IA or IB to UN R3 02 series or later, or UN R150 00 series or later. Pass if a valid approval is present.

requirements.text: Any additional retro-reflecting devices and materials, including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4., shall not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: if additional retro-reflecting devices or materials are fitted, assess their effect on the mandatory lamps. Pass if the effectiveness of the mandatory devices is not impaired.

requirements.text: In width, the point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle measurement: measure the lateral distance from the outermost point of the retro-reflector illuminating surface to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle, on each side. Pass if ≤ 400 mm.

requirements.text: In height, the rear retro-reflector shall be not less than 250 mm above the ground.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle measurement per paragraph 5.8.1 with the vehicle on substantially horizontal ground: measure the lowest edge of the illuminating surface. Pass if ≥ 250 mm.

requirements.text: In height, the rear retro-reflector shall be not more than 900 mm above the ground (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1,200 mm respectively).
requirements.test_case: Vehicle measurement per paragraph 5.8.1: measure the highest edge of the illuminating surface. Pass if ≤ 900 mm, or ≤ 1,200 mm when grouped with the rear lamps (applies to this rear combination lamp), or ≤ 1,500 mm where the bodywork shape prevents compliance.

requirements.text: In length, the rear retro-reflector shall be at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify the retro-reflector is located at the rear of the vehicle. Pass if it is located at the rear.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall have a horizontal geometric visibility angle of 30° inwards and 30° outwards.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check on vehicle or CAD: verify an unobstructed illuminating surface view at 30° inwards and 30° outwards. Pass if visible over the full horizontal range.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall have a vertical geometric visibility angle of 10° above the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Geometric visibility check: verify an unobstructed view at 10° upward. Pass if visible.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall have a vertical geometric visibility angle of 10° below the horizontal; where the retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Measure the mounting height per paragraph 5.8.1, then verify an unobstructed view at 10° downward (or 5° if mounted below 750 mm). Pass if visible over the applicable angle.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection: verify that the reference axis of the retro-reflector faces rearwards. Pass if oriented rearwards.

requirements.text: The angles of geometric visibility of the rear position, stop and reversing lamps and the rear retro-reflector shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 2.10.7. of this Regulation, and the values measured shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled, except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3º variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: Measure angles of geometric visibility per paragraph 2.10.7.; pass if each function meets its individual specified angles, with a tolerance of ±3º on the angle limits.

requirements.text: The visibility of red light from the rear position lamp, stop lamp and rear retro-reflector towards the front of the vehicle shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check per paragraph 5.10. that red light is not directly visible towards the front within the prescribed zone; pass if paragraph 5.10. is fulfilled.

requirements.text: The visibility of white light towards the rear of the vehicle shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check per paragraph 5.10. that no white light other than that permitted (e.g. reversing lamp) is visible towards the rear; pass if paragraph 5.10. is fulfilled.

requirements.text: When verifying that no red light from the rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, red retro-reflector) is visible to the front of the vehicle (see paragraph 5.10.4.), zone 1 explored by the eye of the observer shall be bounded in height by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m respectively above the ground.
requirements.test_case: Install the lamp on the vehicle on substantially horizontal ground. Observe the lamp from the front within zone 1, between heights of 1 m and 2.2 m above ground. Pass if no red light from the lamp is directly visible to an observer within this zone.

requirements.text: When verifying that no red light from the rear combination lamp is visible to the front of the vehicle, zone 1 shall be bounded in width by a vertical plane forming to the front an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane and passing through the point of contact of the vertical plane parallel to the median longitudinal plane delimiting the vehicle's overall width; if there are several points of contact, the foremost shall correspond to the forward plane.
requirements.test_case: Geometric check on the vehicle. Construct the 15° outward forward plane through the foremost point of contact of the overall-width plane. Observe from all positions in zone 1 between 1 m and 2.2 m above ground. Pass if no red light from the lamp is directly visible.
